narrative.intro: Lumen Technologies Government Solutions recorded $91.3M in contract obligations in FY2027 to date across 6 awards, with an average award size of $15.2M. Obligations are down 74.6% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations peaked at $423M in FY25 and have declined to $91.3M in FY27. The Department of Veterans Affairs accounted for the recorded FY27 obligations, while the Department of Agriculture, the International Trade Commission, and the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation show $0 in FY27 obligations. Current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is still in progress. The firm’s FY-level history shows substantial variation: FY22 at $160M, FY23 at $352M, FY24 at $280M, FY25 at $423M, FY26 at $359M, and FY27 at $91.3M. Procurement professionals should note the concentration of FY27 obligations with a single agency and the reduced award flow so far this fiscal year. That concentration and the year-over-year decline are the clearest signals in the FY27 obligations data.
